summary: Added controlled AutoAdjustPanel for whole-image deterministic Ferby tonal adjustment. Reused existing defaults and bounds, validates dimensions, finite strength, percentile ranges and low<high before explicit Apply callback; no canvas, raster, IO or side effects. Added plain exports and README documenting non-equivalence to Shottr and C12 raster ownership.
